caption:
6 prompts for exam week.

1. Make a 5 day revision plan from this syllabus.
2. Which topics carry the most marks? Use these past papers.
3. Ask me 10 likely exam questions, one at a time.
4. Mark my answer like a strict examiner.
5. Make a one page cheat sheet of formulas.
6. Give me memory tricks for these 5 terms.

Save this and send it to your study group.
